caption: The drawing consists of a lightly sketched, realistic depiction of a single spoon centered diagonally on an off-white or beige background. The spoon is rendered in shades of gray, capturing its shape, curvature, and gentle reflective surface. To the upper left of the main image, there is a rectangular inset showing a simple outline of the spoon from a top-down view. In the lower right corner, another rectangular inset contains an outline that shows the side profile of the spoon, emphasizing its curve and the shallow bowl. All elements are drawn with fine pencil lines, and the composition is clean, with ample empty space on the paper. Minimal shading is used except for the main depiction of the spoon. There is some faint text at the bottom edge of the main square frame.
title: Silver Spoon
